scenario: LGRA.4.1 / LEXP.8.8 / LUNI — a const folds unit literals and same-dimension conversion: `const REACH = 2_km + 500_meter` converts each unit literal to base metres (2000 + 500) and folds to a single dimensioned constant. Pin: compiles and inlines at the length-typed comparison.
rules_ds:
unit km: length = x * 1000

const REACH = 2_km + 500_meter

schema Sensor scope logical:
    dist: meter key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.dist > REACH
->
    log info "x"
